lines.t: Bitcoin's sinking again, and I've stopped checking.
Joj, my nephew says that's how fortunes start.
Fortunes? It was nearly eighty, now it's sliding.
Ajme, nobody needs imaginary coins in August.
I know, but I bought before this drop.
Dobro, he bought some, then lost sleep.
Ethereum's weak too, and the cheaper ones look worse.
He calls it investment, I call it madness.
Still, I keep refreshing, hoping it turns.

conv.topic: the fire inland and the smoke over the hill

lines.t: That yellow one turns tighter than I ever could.
Those planes have fought these hills for decades.
I could handle one of those, easy.
You'd handle the heat for five minutes.
Joj, look at smoke rolling over the hill.
I remember thicker smoke, back in the seventies.
Same sun, different summer, still the cicadas scream.
And those planes keep coming, thank goodness.
I'd fly one, if they let me.

conv.topic: the price of everything this summer

lines.t: Coffee used to cost two coins, not this.
Now they charge five, and call it normal.
My electricity bill jumped like a frightened cat.
Joj, mine was nearly double last August.
Even a parasol costs more than lunch.
We bought one for twenty, years ago.
Now twenty gets you the crooked one.
And coffee outside costs what dinner did.
Ma daj, soon we'll pay for shade by minute.

conv.topic: politics and who is supposed to be dealing with any of it

lines.t: They promised the new road before summer.
Still dust. They call it progress every summer.
Who fixes it, then?
The ones in charge, whenever it suits them.
They know Bitcoin's under eighty, but miss the smoke.
Ma daj, they cannot count the planes overhead.
Aircraft work inland.
The sea promised nothing.
Give it a week, and they will promise again.

conv.topic: ethereum, which he is explaining badly

lines.t: Ethereum is like Bitcoin, but more organised.
Organised how? It still loses value.
It runs smart contracts, basically money with instructions.
Who writes the instructions, then?
People do, but the network checks them automatically.
Checks them against what, exactly?
Against everyone else's copy, obviously.
And who fixes it when everyone copies nonsense?
The people who understand Ethereum, I suppose.
Dogecoin's nine cents now. The joke got expensive.
It stopped being funny around the time it became money.
I bought some years ago, purely for the laugh.
And now you won't say how much.
Because discretion is worth more than nine cents.
Joj, that's either wisdom or a terrifying amount.
I can still do a handstand, so I'm diversified.
That is not what diversified means, athlete.
Fine, but under eighty for Bitcoin sounds worse.

conv.topic: rent, tourists and working two jobs in August

lines.t: Rent went up again, like tourists needed encouragement.
They pay August rates, then ask for winter prices.
I work mornings, nights, and apparently rent negotiations.
Two jobs, one beach, zero time to swim.
Ma daj, even the sea feels fully booked.
At least tourists leave, landlords keep raising prices.
Bitcoin's under eighty, my rent keeps climbing.
Maybe I should charge tourists by the towel.
You'd earn more than both jobs combined.

conv.topic: one of them lost money trading and the other saw it coming

lines.t: My Litecoin loss is strategically temporary.
Even the fire planes saw that cliff coming.
That's not timing, that's a temporary setback.
Ma daj, you were buying more that morning.
I was managing risk, like a professional.
You were managing panic with both hands.
Bitcoin rescued my reputation, more or less.
Nothing rescued your balance, especially not Litecoin.
Keep laughing, the next run starts soon.

conv.topic: whether any of it is worth holding for ten years

lines.t: Even half asleep, Bitcoin under eighty looks expensive.
Expensive is fine when ten years changes everything.
Or changes nothing except your blood pressure.
You keep calling it a casino without studying odds.
The odds are hidden, and dealers change.
Then hold several, not one fragile promise.
Ethereum near two and a half thousand is gambling.
It has builders, actual uses, and ten years.
Builders can still build a casino.

conv.topic: bitcoin, as reported by somebody's father

lines.t: Dad says bitcoin is nearly eighty thousand now.
That sounds like a number for a submarine.
He said it went up and down.
Like a jellyfish, except less squishy.
Apparently you can buy tiny pieces of it.
Can you buy one with a shell?
No, but maybe with two and a half thousand.
Joj, that is too much for jellyfish.
His phone said another coin was two thousand.

conv.topic: the aeroplane that scoops water out of the channel

lines.t: It takes more than you think.
It fills up in seconds.
It could lift our little boat, easily.
No chance, boats are much too heavy.
But it lifted a whole channel of water.
Water is nothing compared with Dad's boat.
The big one could carry both of us.
It would sink before reaching the plane.
Its wings are wider than this beach.

conv.topic: the news, and a son who has gone abroad to work

lines.t: They say the planes are still working inland.
I saw them before swimming, going back and forth.
And your son, is he still abroad?
Still there, yes, fixing kitchens until winter.
He must be saving well, with everything so dear.
A little. He watches bitcoin, under eighty now.
Joj, even the coins are having a bad summer.
Ethereum's two and a half thousand, he says.
Does he talk about coming home?

conv.topic: pensions, prices and how hot it has got

lines.t: This heat gets worse every August, even here.
I thought the sea would save us.
The sea is warm, and pensions stay small.
Mine disappears before the month has properly started.
Prices climb faster than my pension ever does.
Bitcoin's under eighty, yet nobody feels richer.
Joj, my neighbour says it was higher yesterday.
Yesterday, everything cost less, including shade.
The pension arrives after the hottest days.

conv.topic: litecoin, and an old man who is not impressed by any of it

lines.t: Litecoin is holding near fifty odd.
That is cheap, especially beside Bitcoin.
Cheap money has fooled me before.
But Litecoin has speed, and room to climb.
Old money had speed too, sometimes.
This is digital, not coins in mattresses.
Digital money still disappears.
Ma daj, you distrust every new fortune.
I have watched fortunes become dust.

conv.topic: the news, the government and the ferry timetable

lines.t: The news says everything is improving, naturally.
That is what they always say.
Meanwhile, the ferry loses another departure.
I saw the timetable, it is thinner again.
Three boats on paper, two when needed.
And the last one leaves absurdly early.
The government plans like a badly printed timetable.
Ma daj, even crypto looks better organised.
Bitcoin's near eighty thousand, and everyone shrugs.

conv.topic: whether it was worse before, which neither of them can settle

lines.t: Gori već treći dan, a nikoga nije briga.
Ma pusti. Uvik gori, uvik ista priča.
Moja mater je pamtila jedno gore lito.
Kod tebe je uvik prije bilo gore.
Bilo je gore. I puno jeftinije.
Kava je sad ka cila večera.
A unuk mi stalno kupuje one nove kovanice.
Nek kupuje. Ja ne virujem ni banci.
Pametan je on. Ali još je mlad.
